Lines @VERSION@ (pre-alpha), Windows x64
https://github.com/anaremore/lines

A native futures charting platform. Pre-alpha: not ready for trading. Public builds
cannot route orders and carry only mock, replay and Coinbase public data.

Run
  lines.exe                      CQG-protocol mock (synthetic ES data)
  lines.exe --source coinbase    live BTC/USD from Coinbase's public feed (internet)
  lines.exe --help               all options

The executable is not code-signed yet. Windows SmartScreen may warn on first run:
choose "More info", then "Run anyway".
